knownDeltas: The swatch imageData is renderer output, so it is excluded from the semantic diff and gated structurally instead (valid PNG, 20x20): swatch pixels are never byte-compared against Esri's sample render.
The legend url is an engine-derived swatch key for the published style, not Esri's sample hash.

The legend swatch 'url' is a per-process System.HashCode token, so it is nondeterministic across restarts and excluded from the diff (only pinned non-empty); follow-up T-085 filed for a stable content hash.
name: mapserver-legend
notes: Legend (MapServer/legend): one swatch entry per published layer, projected from the persisted style so it agrees with the layer drawingInfo.
source: Esri REST docs: Legend (Map Service) (https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/legend-map-service-.htm); SampleWorldCities/MapServer/legend pattern
